sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: An aromatic annual reaching about 1 m, with finely divided leaves and yellow umbels. Its native range runs from North Africa to Iran and the Arabian Peninsula; it is also widely cultivated.

sections.title: Food and comparison
sections.text: The leaves and dry fruits are used as food and seasoning. The culinary “seeds” are actually compressed, winged dry fruits. Dill is related to fennel (Foeniculum vulgare), but is generally smaller and annual, with winged fruits and a different scent.
